Home / Developers / Your own model

Your own model

Keep your model private, or rent it out later.

For a company in a field

  • Our engineers adapt an open model to your field's own data, with you, as an engagement. You do not need a machine-learning team.
  • It runs on our hosting. Your data and the model's weights stay yours, and no other customer reaches it unless you list it.
  • Every answer's receipt names the model that gave it and what it cost.

Talk to us about your field

For a model maker

List your model. Keep 90 % of what renters pay.

  • Set your price per million tokens and say which kinds of work your model is good at.
  • The router sends matching calls from other customers to your model, and each call has a receipt.
  • Your share is credited to your account at once and buys usage, seats or top-ups. Cash payouts are not built yet.
  • Listing is open to invited partners first.

Ask for an invitation

What is built, and what is not

Built

  • A rentable listing with its own price per million tokens
  • Declared specialities the router reads
  • Routing other customers' calls to a listed model
  • The owner's share credited per call
  • A receipt that names the model

Not yet

  • Cash payouts to model owners
  • Training as a self-service product: adapting a model is an engagement our engineers do
